findings.description: AWS access key material is embedded directly in Lambda environment variables. These values are stored in Terraform configuration/state and are available to principals able to read the function configuration, creating a credential disclosure and reuse risk.
The function uses the deprecated and end-of-life nodejs12.x runtime, which no longer receives security updates and may expose the function to known runtime vulnerabilities.
